conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="agent.googleapis.com/disk/percent_used" AND resource.type="gce_instance" AND resource.labels.project_id="<PROJECT_ID>" AND metric.labels.state="used" AND metric.labels.device != monitoring.regex.full_match(".*loop.*")
